text: The Taskforce is led by the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet, providing a whole-of-economy perspective. It focuses on standardizing hazard definitions, integrating data and mapping efforts, and coordinating with existing initiatives like the Hazards Insurance Partnership and the Cyclone Reinsurance Pool. The Taskforce aims to address both risk reduction and affordability, linking to national risk mapping and profiling efforts.

metadata.solution_name: Insurance Affordability and Natural Hazards Risk Reduction Taskforce
